title: Chicken Little
summary: Тэнгэр унаж байна гэж айсан Chicken Little болон түүнд итгэсэн шувуудын үлгэр.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Mario Ritter Jr. · VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Mario Ritter, Jr. adapted this story for VOA Learning English from stories in the public domain.

changes: Excerpt: the introduction before the story was left out; the story itself is complete.

questions.prompt: Why did Chicken Little think the sky was falling?
options: A flower petal fell on her tail
A big rock fell from the sky
questions.explain: Үнээ цэцэг хазаж таслахад "a flower petal fell on her tail". Тэр үүнийг тэнгэр унаж байна гэж бодсон.

questions.prompt: Who first told the other birds that the sky was falling?
questions.explain: Шувууд бие биенээсээ асуухад эцэст нь бүгд "Chicken Little told me" гэж хариулдаг. Тэнгэр унаж байна гэж анх Chicken Little хэлсэн.

questions.prompt: What probably happened to the birds at the end?
questions.explain: Үнэг хаалгаа хаасны дараа "no one ever saw Chicken Little or her friends again". Тэднийг үнэг идсэн бололтой.
